speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with gait and limb ataxia; please tell me, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; when you say "recently," do you mean symptoms began days, weeks, or months ago? Additionally, have you noticed any difficulty speaking, swallowing, or facial weakness on the right side?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

I have determined your diagnosis based on your history of Crohn's disease, treatment with natalizumab, and the presentation of subacute gait and limb ataxia. To confirm this, I request the following:
REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with and without contrast.
REQUEST IMAGES
